page.overview:
What is Zadehl Westersands?

Zadehl Westersands is a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. It comprises the western area of the Zadehl Desert, located southeast of the Lanzelt region's most important settlement, Grandport.

This additional exploration appears as part of the side quest "A Knight of Grandshelt".
